display.purpose: The landing hero only — 900 weight, the one massive moment.

shadows.name: glow-subtle
shadows.purpose: Wordmark, resting CTA — a sensation of emission, not an effect.

shadows.name: glow-medium
shadows.purpose: CTA hover, hero highlight words — the object the user should act on.

shadows.name: glow-strong
shadows.purpose: At most one element per page (today: the closing band headline).

motion.name: phosphor-breathe
motion.purpose: The slow luminous breathing — one element per page, motion-safe only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The luminous action: phosphor fill on near-black, hover raises luminosity to pure white with a stronger halo.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary, #EAF8FF); color: var(--primary-foreground, #050607); height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(120,195,255,0.16); transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(140,205,255,0.35), 0 0 22px rgba(120,195,255,0.22); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(155,216,255,0.5); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Matte support action on Soft Black — no light of its own.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--secondary, #101416); color: var(--secondary-foreground, #EAF8FF); height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(16,20,22,0.8); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(155,216,255,0.5); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Elevated Black surface with a cold hairline; hover on clickable cards brightens the border, never the fill.
components.html:
Documentation client

Ce que votre client lira — rien n'est publié sans votre accord.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card, #0A0D0F); color: var(--card-foreground, #EAF8FF); border: 1px solid rgba(190,230,255,0.12); border-radius: 0.875rem; padding: 1.5rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(190,230,255,0.2); } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; margin: 0 0 0.5rem; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--muted-foreground, #8C999F); margin: 0; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Elevated fill with a visible cold stroke; focus shifts the border toward Cold Glow.
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--card, #0A0D0F); color: var(--foreground, #EAF8FF); border: 1px solid rgba(190,230,255,0.18); border-radius: 0.5rem; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #8C999F); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: rgba(155,216,255,0.6); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(155,216,255,0.35); }

components.name: Nav Wordmark
components.description: The slightly phosphorescent wordmark — plain readable text first, halo as decoration on top.
components.css: .ds-wordmark { color: var(--primary, #EAF8FF); font-weight: 900; font-size: 1.25rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(120,195,255,0.16); }

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.description: Uppercase letter-spaced label — matte muted text, never a heading, never lit.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { color: var(--muted-foreground, #8C999F); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Highlight (Hero)
components.description: Highlight-By-Light: emphasized words are pure white with a halo — a brightness step, never a hue change.
components.css: .ds-hl-line { color: var(--foreground, #EAF8FF); font-weight: 900; font-size: 2rem; margin: 0; text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(120,195,255,0.16); } .ds-hl { color: #FFFFFF; text-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(140,205,255,0.35), 0 0 22px rgba(120,195,255,0.22); }

narrative.overview: A contemporary, premium, editorial brand — with the faint memory of a very good screen. The CRT reference is a texture, not a theme: a slightly cold white, real depth in the blacks, and a barely-there optical diffusion around the few elements allowed to emit. BRAND DESIGN FIRST, optical effects second — roughly 90% contemporary editorial design, 10% optical memory. Matte by default; 5–10% of elements may seem to emit. The signature light is Optical Light #DDF5FF: emphasized words, focus rings, the specular rim of the CTAs (React Bits SpecularButton, dark glass, autoAnimate). The nav is a GlassSurface strip; the hero carries the SideRays diffuse light with grain living inside the halo.
keyCharacteristics: Single dark theme; ground #080A0B with felt-not-seen depth (cold diffusion, soft vignette, ~1.5% grain). No scanlines, no screen frame.
BLACK + WHITE + LIGHT: blue-green lives inside the light (halos, focus, specular rims) and as the emphasis words — never as fills or long text runs.
Matte by default; hierarchy by size, weight, rhythm, composition. No outline type, no tracked-out titles.
Urbanist for everything read; Geist Mono, sparingly, for editorial-scientific labels (tracking ≤0.08em).
Every composition must stand with all effects disabled (Effect-Removal Test).

rules.name: The Localized-Light Rule
rules.body: Optical effects are never global: diffusion around the logo, a hover bloom, one diffuse light behind a section, texture inside a media panel. Never page-wide devices, permanent container halos, or glow on body text.

rules.name: The Effect-Removal Test
rules.body: Remove any effect: the design must still be strong. If not, redesign the composition.

rules.name: The Emphasis-By-Light Rule
rules.body: An emphasized run inside a headline is Optical Light #DDF5FF in full letterforms — the one place the hue carries words. Reserved for the few words where the sentence turns.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Any uppercase label is a label, never a heading — tracking ≤0.08em.

rules.name: The No Second Accent Rule
rules.body: No hue accent as fills. Status colors are functional semantics only.

dos: Do design matte-first, then at most 2–3 subtle optical details per viewport.
Do keep the signature light rare: emphasis words, focus, specular rims.
Do keep borders as quiet hairlines that rise only slightly on hover.
Do keep mono labels sparse and lightly tracked.
donts: Don't reintroduce screen-identifiable devices: scanlines, viewport frames, terminal grids, glitch, neon.
Don't use outline type, tracked-out titles, or permanent glows on containers or body text.
Don't use nameable gradients — depth, not decor.
Don't apply the Signature Card treatment to ordinary cards.
